text:
emma.growth: Quick flag — saw a weird shift in inbound routing this morning after the launch. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/inbound-overview :eyes:
jamal.data: looking now. initial glance: direct and unknown sources up ~45% last 6h vs baseline. pulling raw events
jamal.data: SQL snippet: `SELECT utm_source, count(*) as leads FROM lead_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 desc;`
sophie.ops: any recent GTM or campaign tag changes? I didn't touch the tracking sheet yesterday.
olivia.prodmgmt: we did toggle the new webinar promo on at 03:12 UTC, but tags were unchanged. I'll re-check the campaign link generator.
mike.salesops: salesops seeing a bunch of leads with no source, claiming higher close intent. might be legit but need correct attribution for reports
jamal.data: aha — attribution window was accidentally flipped from 7d to 24h in the ETL config during last deploy (config PR #492). that will inflate 'recent' counts and surface more unknowns.
emma.growth: ugh. is that why the dashboard shows the spike? can we backfill?
jamal.data: we can backfill for reporting, but near-term fix: revert window to 7d and re-run pipeline. will take ~18m to reprocess 48h of events.
dash-bot: [alert] Anomaly detected: sessions tagged ad_partner_x increased x3 in region EU-west-1 (2026-03-21T03:30:12Z) :warning:
olivia.prodmgmt: ad_partner_x? we paused that partner last week — could be stale campaign URL still circulating. I can reach out.
mike.salesops: can we add a temporary routing rule: unknown_source -> manual-review queue so AE's don't get spammed?
sophie.ops: yep, can add rule in routing config for 30m window. doing it now.
sophie.ops: added `route_unknown_to=manual-review` for 30m, will monitor logs.
jamal.data: reprocess started (job 7842). ETA ~22m. I'll post results when done.
emma.growth: thanks. once reprocessed let's snapshot the dashboard and call a quick 15-min sync at 10:15 PT to decide messaging tweaks and whether to roll back the webinar promo.
olivia.prodmgmt: on calendar. also will check landing page UTM builder — possible missing `utm_medium` fallback.
mike.salesops: I'll prepare a short sample of affected leads & suggested canned outreach for manual-review queue.
jamal.data: reprocess finished. numbers back to expected range. the spike was mostly due to the 24h window + ~120 leads from ad_partner_x with broken utm. attached sample ids: `L-8731, L-8740, L-8742`
emma.growth: perfect. action items: (1) olivia: confirm partner pause + fix UTM generator, (2) sophie: keep routing rule for 1h and then remove, (3) jamal: add guard in ETL so window flips require a PR flag, (4) mike: outreach for manual-review leads. I'll take notes and update the weekly KPI deck before tomorrow's review. :thumbsup:
jamal.data: will open PR for ETL guard now (link to PR forthcoming).
olivia.prodmgmt: pinged partner, they confirmed stale creatives. pushing fix for link builder.
sophie.ops: routing rule removed after 50m, queue cleared — no further unknown flood.
emma.growth: thanks everyone, closing thread. if anything else pops up DM me. :sparkles:
